subject: Request: VP/CFO clearance for PulseSync starter-rate carveout
messages:

To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot pricing ask + SSO/PII notes

Irene —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. PulseSync is excited about the latency profile and the KV cache features; our clinical workflows map well to Redwood's serving model. We have a small internal pilot (12 wks, ~2M tokens/month avg) but need a starter rate and packaging that keeps the pilot within our procurement constraints. Two asks: 

1) Can Redwood offer a 35% starter discount off list for the 12-week pilot (we’re a tight nonprofit-backed health provider with limited procurement flexibility)?
2) We need SSO + an evidence pack for SOC 2 scoping and data retention (this will be a gating item for our InfoSec team).

If we can get pilot pricing and a simple MOA, we can move to a paid POC with a path to a 12-month commitment (estimated ARR potential shown in the attached forecast).

Attaching our forecast for context.

—Alex

PulseSync Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot pricing ask + SSO/PII notes — recommendation

Irene / Jonas —

Summary of PulseSync ask: 35% starter discount for a 12-week pilot, plus SOC2 evidence and SSO. They estimate ~2M tokens/month during pilot and are a credible early partner in a strategic clinical vertical. Forecast attached.

My recommendation: Approve a time-bound carveout but limit the discount to 25% for the 12-week pilot and require a conversion trigger (minimum 6-month commitment at renewal pricing within 30 days of pilot end). Also require them to sign a short MOA (we can reuse the standard pilot MOA).

Rationale: 35% is steep and sets a bad precedent for other health vertical pilots. 25% gives the partner meaningful economics while protecting unit economics. We can offer the SOC2 evidence pack and SSO; that’s operationally straightforward. The revenue trade-off is manageable if we make the conversion clause explicit.

Impact: Estimated haircut vs. list for the pilot ~ $8.5k (see forecast). Upside: pipeline conversion could be 3–4x ARR if clinical rollout succeeds.

Attachments: PulseSync_Monthly_Forecast.xlsx

Can you weigh in? If we agree, I’ll prep the exception memo for VP/CFO sign-off.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: EXCEPTION REQUEST: PulseSync starter-rate carveout (DEAL-8421)

Marcus —

Requesting VP/CFO clearance for a starter-rate carveout for PulseSync Health (DEAL-8421). Below is a concise memo — full exception PDF attached.

Ask: Approve a 25% starter discount off list for a 12-week pilot (<=2M tokens/month) + SOC2 evidence pack + SSO; include a conversion trigger to convert to a minimum 6-month paid commitment within 30 days of pilot end at renewal pricing. Add a capped burst surcharge to protect against high single-day consumption.

Why this matters: PulseSync is a prominent regional clinical partner; converting them to a 12-month commitment would exceed $240k ARR (model in attached forecast). Granting a limited, time-boxed discount materially increases probability of conversion without significant long-term revenue leakage if tied to conversion terms.

Financial impact: Estimated gross revenue concession for the pilot = ~$8.5k; expected ARR upside > $240k if the conversion clause is executed. The deal is early-stage but strategically valuable for clinical benchmarks and a reference case.

Operational guardrails: 
- SOC2 evidence pack will be delivered within 5 business days of MOA signature.
- SSO integration slot reserved for week 2 of pilot; limited to SAML 2.0.
- Burst surcharge: >500k tokens/day triggers $0.02/token surcharge after first 500k tokens that day.
- MOA to include data handling appendix and limited retention window (30 days).

Attachments: discount-exception-memo.pdf, PulseSync_Monthly_Forecast.xlsx

Decision requested: VP/CFO sign-off or alternate direction. If approved, I will notify the customer and route the term sheet to Legal for MOA prep.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations, North America
Redwood Inference
attachments: discount-exception-memo.pdf (pdf); PulseSync_Monthly_Forecast.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 12:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EXCEPTION REQUEST: PulseSync starter-rate carveout (DEAL-8421) — APPROVED w/conditions

Irene —

Approve the 25% starter discount for a 12-week pilot on the conditions below:

1) Add the conversion clause verbatim into the MOA (minimum 6-month commitment, renewal pricing, conversion window 30 days).
2) Implement the burst surcharge exactly as proposed.
3) Escalation trigger: if daily consumption >750k tokens for more than 3 days, Sales must pause new feature exposures and notify Finance immediately.

I want legal to include a short recoupment clause: if PulseSync does not convert within the window, Redwood may invoice an amount equal to 50% of the pilot concession as a one-time recovery fee. This is to discourage pilots that never convert. Legal/RevOps should draft the exact language.

Once Legal confirms MOA language, proceed. Marissa — please coordinate. Jonas — support the SSO/SOC2 scoping.

Approved — Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP Finance (interim CFO)
